race.comment: THE IRON STAR (4) improving gelding who saves his best for the home track. Won over this track and trip two-back, then jumped in class on the heavy (9) surface with a disappointing sixth over 1800m at Randwick in BM78 class. Gets the right tempo today and finds a much easier assignment. Go close. VIEWPOINT (3) desperate for a firmer surface and extra ground. Failed to make an impression on the heavy track when sixth over 1500m at Rosehill in BM72 class. Has the talent to score a well-deserved victory. INCEPTION (9) racing well and no excuses here from the good barrier. Took control early from the outside gate with a gritty second over 1600m at Wyong. Takes control early and has claims on his best figures. LUGARNO (1) in need of the run first-up with a battling sixth over 1350m at Wyong. Proven second-up and stays in the calculations.
